question: The company will ______ employees for any travel expenses related to business trips.
chinese: 公司會退還員工出差相關的所有旅費。
explanation: reimburse（退還費用、補償）符合「公司會退還員工出差旅費」；resign辭職、reserve保留/預訂、resume恢復/履歷，都是常見商務字但語意不合。
optionNotes: 動詞・恢復；名詞・履歷

question: The two companies spent several weeks trying to ______ a fair contract for both sides.
chinese: 這兩家公司花了好幾週試圖協商出對雙方都公平的合約。
explanation: negotiate（協商、談判）符合「花數週嘗試談出對雙方都公平的合約」；neglect忽略、navigate導航、notify通知，都不符合「談合約」的語境。

question: Due to the CEO's sudden illness, the shareholders' meeting has been ______ until next month.
chinese: 由於執行長突然生病，股東會已延期到下個月。
explanation: postpone（延期）符合「執行長突然生病，股東會延到下個月」；propose提議、promote晉升/推廣、prohibit禁止，字首都是 pro-開頭常見混淆字。

question: Please send the ______ to the accounting department so we can process the payment.
chinese: 請把請款單送到會計部門，以便我們處理付款。
explanation: invoice（發票、請款單）符合「送請款單到會計部門以便處理付款」；income收入、insurance保險、instance例子，語意都不符合。

question: I'd like to introduce you to my ______ , who will be joining us for the project.
chinese: 我想介紹你認識我的同事，他將加入我們的專案。
explanation: colleague（同事）符合「介紹將加入專案的同事」；collateral擔保品、collision碰撞、collection收集，字形相似但意思不同。

question: If we don't meet the ______ , the client may cancel the entire contract.
chinese: 如果我們沒趕上截止期限，客戶可能會取消整個合約。
explanation: deadline（截止期限）符合「沒趕上期限，客戶可能取消整個合約」；decline拒絕/下降、discipline紀律、outline大綱，都不符合語境。

question: The warehouse manager checks the ______ every week to make sure nothing is out of stock.
chinese: 倉庫經理每週都會檢查庫存，確保沒有缺貨。
explanation: inventory（庫存）符合「每週檢查庫存以確保沒有缺貨」；investment投資、instrument儀器/工具、institute機構，語意都不符合。

question: The HR department interviewed five ______ for the marketing position.
chinese: 人資部門面試了五位應徵行銷職位的人。
explanation: candidate（應徵者、候選人）符合「面試了五位應徵行銷職位的人」；campaign活動、capacity容量/能力、category類別，語意都不符合。

question: We need a more ______ supplier who can deliver the parts on time every month.
chinese: 我們需要一個更可靠的供應商，能每個月準時交貨。
explanation: reliable（可靠的）符合「需要能每月準時交貨的更可靠供應商」；relative相對的、relevant相關的、reluctant不情願的，都是 re-開頭常見混淆字。

question: The marketing team has to stay within ______ while planning the new advertising campaign.
chinese: 行銷團隊在規劃新的廣告活動時，必須維持在預算內。
explanation: budget（預算）符合「規劃新廣告活動時要維持在預算內」；benefit利益、behavior行為、bonus獎金，語意都不符合。

question: The board of directors decided to ______ a new marketing strategy to increase sales this quarter.
chinese: 董事會決定實施新的行銷策略，以增加本季的銷售額。
explanation: implement 意思是「實施、執行」，implement a strategy (實施策略) 是多益常考搭配詞；implore 是「懇求」，imitate 是「模仿」，impress 是「使印象深刻」。

question: As a token of our appreciation, all hotel guests will receive a ______ breakfast buffet during their stay.
chinese: 為了表達我們的感謝，所有飯店房客在住宿期間都將獲得免費的自助早餐。
explanation: complimentary 意思是「免費贈送的」，常與 breakfast/beverage 等字連用；complementary 意思是「互補的」，拼字極易混淆；complicated 是「複雜的」，compulsory 是「強制的」。

question: The conference room on the second floor can ______ up to 200 attendees comfortably.
chinese: 二樓的會議室可以舒適地容納多達 200 名與會者。
explanation: accommodate 意思是「容納、提供住宿」，指空間能容納多少人；accumulate 是「累積」，accelerate 是「加速」，accompany 是「陪伴」。

question: Please note that this schedule is ______ and may be subject to changes before the event.
chinese: 請注意，此行程表是暫定的，在活動開始前可能會有變動。
explanation: tentative 意思是「暫定的、初步的」，常用來形容 schedule (行程) 或 agreement (協議)；lucrative 是「獲利豐厚的」，defective 是「有缺陷的」，sensitive 是「敏感的」。

question: Mr. Smith's travel agent sent him a detailed ______ including flight times and hotel reservations.
chinese: 史密斯先生的旅行社發給他一份詳細的行程表，包含了航班時間與飯店預訂。
explanation: itinerary 意思是「旅遊行程表」，是多益旅遊情境的高頻字；inventory 是「庫存、存貨清單」，investigation 是「調查」，interview 是「面試」。

question: Employees who have worked here for more than a year are ______ for the annual bonus.
chinese: 在這裡工作超過一年的員工有資格獲得年度獎金。
explanation: eligible for 意思是「有資格的、符合條件的」，常用於福利或晉升；legible 是「字跡易讀的」，edible 是「可食用的」，flexible 是「有彈性的」。

question: We highly value customer ______ because it helps us improve the quality of our products and services.
chinese: 我們非常重視顧客的回饋，因為這能幫助我們改善產品與服務的品質。
explanation: feedback 意思是「回饋意見」，customer feedback 是常見搭配；setback 是「挫折」，drawback 是「缺點」，playback 是「重播」。

question: The company offered the injured worker financial ______ for the accident that happened in the factory.
chinese: 公司向受傷的工人提供了工廠意外的財務補償。
explanation: compensation 意思是「補償、賠償金」，也常指「薪酬」；competition 是「競爭」，composition 是「組成、作文」，compliment 是「讚美」。

question: The manager decided to ______ more funds to the marketing department for the upcoming advertising campaign.
chinese: 經理決定為即將到來的廣告活動分配更多資金給行銷部門。
explanation: allocate 意思是「分配、撥給」，常接 funds (資金) 或 resources (資源)；relocate 是「搬遷」，locate 是「找出位置」，educate 是「教育」。

question: Attendance at the fire safety seminar next Wednesday is ______ for all new staff members.
chinese: 所有新進員工都強制必須參加下週三的消防安全研討會。
explanation: mandatory 意思是「強制的、必須的」，常與 attendance (出席) 搭配；voluntary 是「自願的」，temporary 是「暫時的」，satisfactory 是「令人滿意的」。
optionNotes: 形容詞・強制的、必須的

question: Applicants must have at least three years of ______ experience in the software development industry.
chinese: 申請者必須在軟體開發產業有至少三年的過往經驗。
explanation: previous 意思是「先前的、過往的」，previous experience (過往經驗) 是求職情境高頻詞；precious 是「珍貴的」，various 是「各種的」，obvious 是「明顯的」。
optionNotes: 形容詞・先前的、過往的

question: Ms. Johnson will be the keynote speaker at the leadership ______ held in the main auditorium.
chinese: 強森女士將擔任在主禮堂舉辦的領導力研討會的專題演講者。
explanation: seminar 意思是「研討會」，是多益常見字；semester 是「學期」，sensation 是「感覺、轟動」，senior 是「資深者、大四生」。

question: The tech company plans to ______ its latest generation of smartphones globally next month.
chinese: 這家科技公司計畫下個月在全球發表其最新一代的智慧型手機。
explanation: launch 意思是「發表、推出(新產品)」，符合科技公司推出新手機的語境；lunch 是「午餐」，lounge 是「休息室」，latch 是「門閂」。

question: Please ______ your billing address before submitting your final order on our website.
chinese: 在我們的網站上提交最終訂單之前，請核對您的帳單地址。
explanation: verify 意思是「核對、確認」，verify an address/account (核對地址/帳戶) 是網購常見語境；vary 是「變化」，vanish 是「消失」，violate 是「違反」。

question: All client records and financial data are highly ______ and must not be shared with outside parties.
chinese: 所有客戶紀錄與財務數據都是高度機密的，不得與外部各方分享。
explanation: confidential 意思是「機密的」，常修飾 document (文件) 或 information (資訊)；confident 是「自信的」，convenient 是「方便的」，conventional 是「傳統的、常規的」。
